title: Find Mirror Score of a String
summary: Given a string, define the mirror of a letter as its counterpart when the alphabet is reversed.
statement: Given a string, define the mirror of a letter as its counterpart when the alphabet is reversed. Starting with a score of zero, iterate through the string from left to right, marking the closest unmarked index where the mirror of the current character matches the current character, and add the difference between the indices to the score. Return the total score after processing the entire string.
constraints: The mirror pairs a with z, b with y, and so on.
Scanning left to right, match each character with the closest earlier unmarked mirror when one exists and add their index distance.
hints: For each letter, unmatched positions are consumed in last-in-first-out order.
Maintain one stack per letter and consult the mirrored letter’s stack.
Pop the closest mirror and add the distance; otherwise push the current index.
A later unmatched mirror is always closer, and consuming it cannot improve any earlier index already processed.
editorial: A later unmatched mirror is always closer, and consuming it cannot improve any earlier index already processed.

tests.explanation: The z at index two pairs with a at zero, and x at four pairs with c at one, totaling five.
The z pairs with the earlier a at distance one.
